name: @trembus-demo/foundry-room
description: Foundry Room · Maid — a demo SITE consuming @trembus/ui via its published API (workspace:* + ./styles.css). Composes the real components (FolderTree, Dialog, Table, Badge, Tooltip, and the new Stepper) into a governed file-room explorer. NOT a library: no 3-jobs contract, off the `pnpm validate` gate; scripts are named off the gated set (dev/build:site/preview/tc). Dog-food check: `pnpm demos:check` from the repo root.
